notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough subpage exists but is short (about 1,800 characters), with only Gameplay and a Table of Contents beside it. theouterworlds.fandom.com answers the API, with about 36 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The original Steam release is not in the Steam store list, so the Steam data comes from The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition (app 1920490; the schema calls it "TOW SCE"). RAWG lists that edition separately (2023), but the 2019 RAWG entry was kept. 31 of 68 Steam achievements are hidden. The expansions are named in the data (Peril on Gorgon, Murder on Eridanos); hidden ones listed after each expansion's completion achievement were put in that expansion by schema position, as were "Good Listener" (phonographs) and "Special P.E.T. Benefits". That split is an inference and needs checking. The other hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; some with low unlock rates (such as "Mightier than the Sword", "Ludwig was Right" and "Sunburn") may be optional.
